description_excerpt: Job Description Summary GE Vernova is establishing a Legal Center of Efficiency, and this is the founding legal role responsible for helping design, build, and run it. Reporting to the Chief Corporate Counsel and working in close partnership with Legal Operations, the successful candidate will provide hands-on legal review and negotiation while standing up a scalable, technology-enabled model for handling high-volume, repeatable agreements – beginning with non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) – that reduces demand on senior legal resources, improves consistency, and speeds the business.
